# Polynovea

> Polynovea is a deep-tech AI, data, behavioural-intelligence and decision-infrastructure company building the Human Behavioral Intelligence Framework (HBIF) — infrastructure for observing, modeling, and acting on human decision-making across commercial and organisational environments. Based in Navi Mumbai, India.

Polynovea builds systems that observe human decision-making, extract the underlying patterns, and convert them into repeatable frameworks, products, and automated systems. Each domain HBIF enters gets its own purpose-built product; underneath every domain's product sits a deeper, shared layer of the infrastructure that gets sharper the more domains it operates across.

## What is Behavioral Intelligence?

Behavioral Intelligence is the systematic capability to observe human decision-making patterns, model the conditions that produce them, and act on that understanding through automated systems.

It is distinct from:
- **Sentiment Analysis** — which measures expressed opinion after the fact
- **Behavioral Economics** — which models theoretical preferences in controlled conditions
- **Analytics** — which aggregates past events without modeling the conditions that produced them

Behavioral Intelligence works with revealed behavior in real environments, in real time, to produce actionable intelligence — not reports.

## The Human Behavioral Intelligence Framework (HBIF)

HBIF is Polynovea's implementation of behavioral intelligence infrastructure, structured as three layers:

- **Layer 1 — Domain Intelligence**: Purpose-built products, one per domain. **Infrakinetic** (Workplace domain) is Polynovea's current lead product for commercialisation and revenue — a full enterprise operating system covering commercial/CRM, finance, HR & payroll, workflow automation, governance, and marketing. **Hospitality's Acquisition System** (Decision Framework, Acquisition System, Optimisation System) is undergoing an architectural rebuild. Education is in the design phase.
- **Layer 2 — Behavioral State & Dynamics**: A shared layer of the infrastructure underneath every domain's product, reading behavioral state and decision-making mechanisms directly, independent of industry. Still being built.
- **Layer 3 — Frontier Decision-Mechanism Research**: Research into human decision mechanisms at the model level. Still being built.

Every new domain's product makes Layers 2 and 3 sharper for every other domain — that's what compounds over time.

## Infrakinetic

Infrakinetic is a Polynovea product: the Workplace domain's Layer 1 system, and Polynovea's current commercial/revenue lead. It is an integrated enterprise business operating system — commercial/CRM, sales, finance, billing & payments, HR/payroll, customer success, workflow, approvals, governance, documents, and business data migration — running on one shared data model instead of disconnected point tools.

Learn more at [infrakinetic.in](https://www.infrakinetic.in).
